ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, if $DE\parallel BC$, $\frac{AD}{BD}=\frac{1}{2}$, and $DE=4\,\text{cm}$, then what is the length of $BC$ in $\,\text{cm}$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $DE\parallel BC$,\\
therefore $\triangle ADE \sim \triangle ABC$,\\
thus $\frac{DE}{BC} = \frac{AD}{AB}$,\\
also, given $\frac{AD}{DB} = \frac{1}{2}$,\\
thus $\frac{AD}{AB}=\frac{1}{3}$,\\
hence $\frac{4}{BC}=\frac{1}{3}$,\\
therefore $BC=\boxed{12}\,\text{cm}$.
